purpose: Teach: 異色/利得/顔写真/開閉/管制/政局/ボーダー/県外

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、異色の経歴の警官もご活躍ですね
lines.en: I see — the police department has officers with quite unconventional backgrounds who do great work.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Genuine curiosity lifting the tone. Nodding slightly as he speaks, as if discovering something interesting in real time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、利得目的の犯罪を捜査されますね
lines.en: And you handle investigations into profit-motivated crimes too, I imagine.
lines.style: Light, encouraging follow-up. Leaning in slightly. The tone of someone drawing out expertise from someone who doesn't often talk about their work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の顔写真を公開されますね
lines.en: You release suspect photographs to the public as well, don't you.
lines.style: Observant, almost thinking aloud. Not quite a question — more a recognition of procedure. Even pace, steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、自動ドアの開閉時刻も証拠になりますね
lines.en: Even something like when an automatic door opens and closes — that becomes evidence in your cases.
lines.style: Slight wonder underneath. The realization that details matter this much. Quiet, appreciative tone. Small pause before 'even'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、交通管制センターと連携されますね
lines.en: You coordinate with the traffic management center for investigations like this.
lines.style: Connecting the pieces aloud. Warm recognition of the scope of work. Moderate pace, almost nodding through the sentence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、政局による予算変動にも対応されますね
lines.en: And you have to adjust to budget changes that come from shifts in political priorities.
lines.style: Sympathetic acknowledgment. Not complaining for them, but recognizing the constraint. Slight drop in energy — the real-world friction showing through.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ボーダー地域の犯罪にも注力されますね
lines.en: Border areas and cross-regional crimes get your attention too, I'd think.
lines.style: Genuine interest returning. The scope of work expanding in his mind as he speaks. Warm and engaged again.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、県外への共同捜査もされますね
lines.en: You work joint investigations with other prefectures when you need to.
lines.style: Close, almost conspiratorial. The sense of finally landing on something both of them understand. Quieter, more direct. The tone of recognition between people doing difficult work.
